description: The image displays two separate bar charts, both plotting Fleiss Kappa values on the vertical axis against different categories on the horizontal axis. The left chart’s horizontal axis is labeled “Ambiguity Std” and shows four bars corresponding to the values 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, with their respective Fleiss Kappa values labeled as 0.88, 0.46, 0.03, and 0.24. The right chart’s horizontal axis is labeled “Max Ambiguity” and shows three bars corresponding to the values 1, 2, and 3, with their respective Fleiss Kappa values labeled as 0.89, 0.46, and 0.23. In both charts, the vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” and ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2. All bars are colored blue, with the left chart’s bars appearing in two shades (dark blue for the first two bars, light blue for the last two) and the right chart’s bars also in two shades (dark blue for the first bar, light blue for the subsequent two). The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of their horizontal axis labels. Each bar has its numerical value explicitly labeled on top. There is no legend or additional visual emphasis such as shading or outlining beyond the color differentiation between the first bar and the remaining bars in each chart.
